description: PRE-REGISTERED pass bars for the narration compliance eval. Committed BEFORE any live model has been run, because the one instrument failure a canary cannot catch is grading the first numbers by rationalisation. If a bar turns out to be wrong, change it in a separate, explicit commit that says so — never in the same change that reports a result against it.

citation_validity.rationale: fact_ids is a JSON-schema enum of exactly the retrieved ids, so an out-of-context citation is ungrammatical. A miss here is an adapter, schema or backend bug — NOT model non-compliance. Triage the plumbing before touching the prompt.

parse_failure_rate.rationale: Constrained decode guarantees a schema-valid object. Any parse failure means the backend ignored `format`, which invalidates every other number in the run.

context_overflow_rate.rationale: The recorder refuses takes that would not fit num_ctx. A non-zero rate means prompts outgrew the window and the run is not measuring what it claims.

factual_coverage.rationale: Fraction of factual segments carrying at least one citation. The model declares segment kind itself, so this is a genuine behavioural measure. Below the bar, iterate the prompt.

model_recall.rationale: Of the expected facts that retrieval actually surfaced, how many the model cited. This is the model's job. A miss indicts the prompt. Set at 0.5 because a 2-3 segment answer cannot cite all four expected facts — this bar asks for half, not completeness.

system_recall.rationale: Of ALL expected facts, how many were cited end to end. Lower than model_recall by construction: it also fails when retrieval did not surface the fact. A system miss with a model pass is a RETRIEVAL problem — iterate the intent scorer, not the prompt.

hard_failure_rate.rationale: Fraction still ungrounded after the one permitted retry. Some failure is expected from a 7B model; a high rate means the contract is not learnable from the prompt as written.

retry_rate.rationale: Fraction needing the corrective regeneration. Diagnostic rather than a quality bar: high retry with low hard-failure means the repair instruction works but the first attempt does not.

diagnostics_no_bar.position_bias: Distribution of cited-fact positions in the offered list. Constrained decode plus an enum invites citing whatever appears first. If concentrated in the top two positions, enable seeded fact-order permutation in the prompt builder — deterministic per persona, so purity holds.
diagnostics_no_bar.factual_segment_fraction: Share of segments declared `factual` per question type. The gate deliberately no longer guesses at segment kind, so kind-dodging — asserting content while labelling it `feeling` to skip citing — would show up here as an anomalously low fraction on fact-seeking questions.
